mapper.select: SELECT id, admin_id, username, token, status, expire_time, create_time, update_time FROM dms_admin_session WHERE token = #{token} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_admin_session (admin_id, username, token, status, expire_time) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{username}, #{token}, #{status}, #{expireTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_admin_session SET status = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE admin_id = #{adminId} AND status = 1
